protocol.timestampResolution: microseconds; seconds/microseconds are range-checked and monotonic, then excluded from the canonical flow key
protocol.checksumPolicy: IPv4, TCP and UDP checksum fields are intentionally zero and are not validated
protocol.ipv4Fragmentation: any MF flag or non-zero fragment offset is rejected as malformed; no reassembly
protocol.tcpReassembly: per-direction contiguous sequence append, maximum 256 payload bytes; gaps/overlap rejected
protocol.dnsCompression: one question; zero or one answer; labels are bounds checked; answer name must be a compression pointer to offset 12; the target name is not recursively expanded because the canonical output is flow metadata
protocol.httpFraming: a reassembled direction is one message only when it begins with GET-space or HTTP-slash
protocol.malformedDisposition: increment malformed-packets, emit no new application message, and continue at the next PCAP record

counterPolicy.allocations: Counts retained semantic arrays, flow records, reassembly arrays, canonical flow list, HTTP aggregate arrays, output word buffer and output byte view. Instrumentation envelopes and engine-internal/transient argument arrays are excluded.
counterPolicy.boundaryCrossings: Zero for the JavaScript controlled parser and one batched input/run/output crossing for linear Wasm.

variants.implementation: bounds-checked project-owned parser and deterministic open-addressed flow table
project-owned C compiled to scalar linear Wasm; parsing, reassembly, DNS validation, HTTP framing, flow updates, sorting and canonical emission all execute in Wasm
